name: Collection Grid
summary: Passive container-responsive product list composed from canonical Product Cards.

anatomy.name: root
anatomy.description: Neutral wrapper that owns page spacing, public token densities, and inline-size containment without adding a landmark or widget role.

anatomy.name: items
anatomy.description: Native unordered list and responsive CSS grid for the current finite product results.

anatomy.name: item
anatomy.description: Repeated native list item containing exactly one canonical Product Card.

sizes.name: default
sizes.description: One intrinsic responsive size: four token-controlled density bands, initially one/two/three/four columns.

states.name: default
states.description: Passive list layout; populated and zero-item content do not add Grid-owned interactive state.

behavior.name: nativeList
behavior.description: Render a native ul/li collection without APG grid, row, or gridcell roles and without a second keyboard model.

behavior.name: productCardComposition
behavior.description: Each item contains one canonical Product Card and does not duplicate its Card, Price, Badge, Button, media, focus, or Quick Look behavior.

behavior.name: containerResponsiveColumns
behavior.description: Respond to the component inline-size: four public density tokens selected at the existing 20rem/48rem/64rem thresholds.

behavior.name: passiveProjection
behavior.description: Filtering, sorting, pagination, loading, result announcements, empty recovery, product data, and virtualization remain parent or target owned.

properties.name: items
properties.description: Ordered collection of zero or more canonical Product Cards, each wrapped by one native list item.

accessibility: Render native ul/li semantics and do not apply APG grid, row, or gridcell roles without the complete composite focus model.
Keep every Product Card and its controls reachable in DOM order; do not use dense packing, CSS order, or layout-only reordering.
Preserve Product Card accessible names, focus, Button, Price, Badge, media, and Quick Look requirements for every list item.
Keep result-count announcements, busy state, filtering focus, pagination, and empty recovery outside the passive Collection Grid.

shopify.notes: The collection page section paginates collection.products, maps the existing wide-column setting to the public --grid-columns token, and renders one canonical Product Card snippet per native list item.
